class.name: NNBTTaskNodes
class.brief_description: Base class for behaviour tree leaf and decorator nodes that run script hooks.
class.description: Provides the [method on_tick] virtual method and optional run lifecycle hooks ([method on_before_run], [method on_after_run], and [method on_interrupt]) for scripted behaviour tree tasks.

method.name: on_before_run
method.description: Optional hook called once when a new run starts, before the first [method on_tick].

method.name: on_after_run
method.description: Optional hook called once when a run finishes with [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. Not called on interrupt.

method.name: on_interrupt
method.description: Optional hook called once when an active run is cancelled (for example, by a reactive parent switching branches, a timeout, or disabling the node).

method.name: on_tick
method.description: Override to implement the task's per-tick logic. Return one of [enum NNBTNodes.Status] ([constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS], [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE], [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING], or [constant NNBTNodes.SKIP]). Access shared data via [method NoodleNodes.get_blackboard] and the actor via [method NoodleNodes.get_actor].
